title: Gis Plugin Migration To Crate And Taxonomy Consolidation
description: W2 batch-2 migration of the 🌍️gis plugin under the CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE master ticket (26/08/05). Merge gis's 15 Rust crates (bundle `semio-s-plugin-gis` + two app facades gis-2d/gis-3d + their engine/dsl/op/pack/protocol/ui modules) into ONE crate at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🌍️gis/📦️packages/🦀️rust/ with the full taxonomy source tree per 📋️TEMPLATE.md: 🗿️artifacts/<a>/{component,🔺️diff,🔧️op,🗣️dsl,🎒️pack,📡️spr,⚙️engine} per artifact and 🎛️apps/{◻2d,🧊️3d}/{component,config,terminology,🎮️commands,🎭️modes,🪟️windows,📌️panels}, wired from a plugin-root 📦️lib.rs by explicit full-path #[path] mod declarations. Decompose both command enums with app_commands!, stitch each app's manifest from per-node definition() fns, preserve wire format byte-identically (before/after hex dumps per app), keep every existing test. Preserve all [package.metadata.*] tables verbatim (component package semio:gis, 2 playground rows with ports 6040/6140 and 6083/6183, 3 tile-proxy asset rows). Never touch root Cargo.toml, root script.ts, registry script, launch.json, or any other plugin's directory (notably 🎪️demonstrator, which depends on gis's old crates and is repointed by the orchestrator).
summary:
W2 migration of 🌍️gis: 15 Rust crates (bundle `semio-s-plugin-gis` + the gis-2d/gis-3d app facades + their engine/dsl/op/pack/protocol/ui modules) merged into ONE crate `semio-s-plugin-gis` at `✏️s/🔌️plugins/🌍️gis/📦️packages/🦀️rust/`, with a 44-node taxonomy source tree wired from a plugin-root `📦️lib.rs` by explicit full-path `#[path]` declarations.

Structure: two artifacts — `🗿️artifacts/🗺️gismap` (gis.map) and `🗿️artifacts/🏔️gisterrain` (gis.terrain), each with all of {🦀️component, 🔺️diff, 🔧️op, 🗣️dsl, 🎒️pack, 📡️spr, ⚙️engine} (📡️protocol renamed to 📡️spr; the `GisMapOperationDsl` mirror + OpText/OpBinary impls moved from op into spr) — and two apps, `🎛️apps/◻2d` (component/config/terminology/maphost/wasm, 🎮️commands×6 groups covering 22 rows, 🎭️modes/✏️edit → 🪟️windows/🗺️map with 6 🎚️options, 📌️panels×3) and `🎛️apps/🧊️3d` (component/config, 🎮️commands×4, 🎭️modes/👁️view → 🪟️windows/🏔️terrain). Both command enums rebuilt with `app_commands!`; both `DocumentApp::handle` impls collapsed to `command.dispatch(doc, cfg)`; both manifests stitched from per-node `definition()` fns via `.mode_def()`/`.window_kind_def()`/`.panel_tab_def()`. Artifact-per-app: one artifact each, no sharing (the 3d app re-declares gismap's `2d.map` ArtifactKindSpec for the `map:in` edge, sourced from the single canonical `artifacts::gismap::artifact_kind()`).

Verification (all via a temporary nested `[workspace]` overlay, removed at handoff): `cargo check` clean (zero warnings for this crate), `cargo check --target wasm32-wasip2` clean, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean, `cargo test` 146/146 green. Pre-migration baseline was 63 passing across the 13 compilable old crates (2d 43, 3d 20) — the gis-3d-ui crate's 9 tests plus the bundle sanity test could never run, see below. Wire format proven byte-identical: pre-migration `print_op | len | hex` dumps of all 22 Gis2dCommand rows + 14 GisMapOperation rows (39 lines) and all 5 Gis3dCommand rows + 3 Gis3dTerrainOperation rows (9 lines) diff with ZERO differences against post-migration dumps; the hex is additionally pinned into permanent tests. Taxonomy audit (local mirror of `validateTaxonomyTree`) clean.

TWO pre-existing bugs found and fixed, both in the never-compiling `semio-s-app-gis-3d-ui` crate: (1) the systemic batch-1 corruption (TEMPLATE §12.3) — `Ok(Emit::amend(vec![...], "gis3d-exaggeration"),` missing its closing paren, plus `Fault` absent from the import list; (2) newly discovered — that crate had NO `command_from_action` override at all, so every declared gis3d action (setCamera/setSelection/worldSelect/setExaggeration) fell through to the trait default's hard error and the whole `{action,args}` host wire was dead. Both fixed in the port; a test using the framework's own `assert_declared_actions_bridge_to_commands` harness now locks the bridge in.

Old crate dirs deleted (🛂️manifest + both apps' ⚡️implementations and 🔨️modules); the temporary `[DEBUG]` wire-baseline test modules added to the two old protocol crates were removed first; the two `📚️examples` fixtures were relocated to `🎛️apps/<app>/📚️examples/` (verified byte-identical) before deletion. Root workspace is now red on exactly gis's 15 dangling member lines until the registrar pass — see 📋️registrar-handoff.md.

Cross-cutting edit made: the dsl `🧪️fixture-sweep` crate's `[dev-dependencies]` gis2d+gis3d collapsed to one `gis` dep on the merged crate, with its two `use` lines repointed to `gis::artifacts::gismap::GisMapDocument` / `gis::artifacts::gisterrain::Gis3dTerrainDocument`. NOT made (orchestrator's interim repoint, per the batch-1 protocol): 🎪️demonstrator's three gis dependencies — the new module paths for every symbol it uses are tabulated in 📋️registrar-handoff.md.
